study.question: Can a modest representation-width reduction and/or a halved local scorer preserve the strongest imported joint model click AUC while reducing measured prediction cost under the unchanged inputs and training recipe?
study.hypothesis: Observed starting point: g0-r0022-support_rotated_attached has click AUC 0.666753547526167, 32129765 parameters (31793216 embedding; 336549 dense), 336.582628 train seconds, 28.627790 full validation inference seconds, and batch p50/p95 23.553096/23.652613 ms. DIN has click AUC 0.6555440824200336 and p50 15.253551 ms. Thus the joint model gains click quality but costs more prediction time; embeddings account for 98.9525% of its parameters, and source inspection shows scoring of 70 compressed slots. Capacity redundancy is unverified. Hypothesis: 12-dimensional representations or a [32,16] scorer can retain the useful compressed information with lower storage and arithmetic. These are routine width controls, not a new unified architecture or a verified novelty claim. Existing auxiliary AUCs are worse than DIN and must remain visible. The only two imported trajectories are successful receipts; the scoped agent-memory search returned no capacity or failed-branch records, so no earlier failure or weaker-model result is treated as local evidence.

nearest_work.difference: Exact source hash and architecture configuration reproduced in the control. Only embedding dimension 16->12 and scorer hidden widths [64,32]->[32,16] change in three standalone candidates. All forward/masking/summary/gradient methods are unchanged. This nearest local implementation, rather than DIN alone, supplies the direct comparison.

Primary exact-version text arXiv:1706.06978v4 read at lines226-286,293-352; cached content SHA256 5fee25f33f375e51b3ee9417d376ff9dbe2ea3628c932a7679ddfeb0feaaade2. DIN supplies target-conditioned unnormalized local activation, embedding lookup and Dice concepts. This study narrows an already adapted four-task compression/residual model; it neither reproduces the original paper training recipe nor introduces a new attention mechanism. The paper does not establish that width reduction transfers to this incumbent.

study.proposed_difference: A 2x2 width study: embedding_dim in {16,12} crossed with attention_hidden_units in {[64,32],[32,16]}. The control is byte-identical to the frozen joint source; three candidate modules are standalone copies with only CONFIG, matching constructor defaults and explanatory module docstring changed. No dead-code optimization, changed support population, new summaries, field removal, loss change, tower narrowing or residual-bank sharing is bundled in. Representation width changes all dependent tensor widths as inherited code dictates. Learned parameter allocation controls are reserved for a later prospectively declared round after evidence identifies a useful factor.
predictions: Frozen screening preservation margin: click AUC(candidate)-AUC(contemporaneous reference) >= -0.0005 AND candidate AUC >= 0.666253547526167 (historical incumbent minus0.0005). This margin allows at most about4.46% loss of the imported incumbent gain over DIN. It is an a priori practical tolerance, not a significance threshold.

Frozen prediction-cost utility criterion: fewer measured total parameters, at least5% reduction in model-only batch latency p50 (candidate/reference <=0.95), and p95 ratio <=1.02 at frozen batch8192 on the same device/precision/data. Report full inference wall seconds, throughput, training and total allocated/wall seconds, examples processed and peak memory independently; no speed claim from parameters or theoretical work alone. One timing pass is screening evidence only.

Embedding12 should reduce embedding parameters by25% from31793216 to23844912 if the host feature map uses the inherited uniform embedding dimension. Expected dimensions and counts must be checked by the host; feature-specific overrides, if any, invalidate this estimate rather than authorize changing the feature map. Scorer-only reduction should leave embedding tables unchanged and lower scorer arithmetic while preserving all70/30 slot populations.

The four cells identify single-factor width effects and their interaction. If both single reductions preserve AUC but their combination loses it, the two widths are not independently dispensable under this recipe. Conversely a successful combination does not establish success of either factor alone.

Report click and all auxiliary AUC/Logloss plus auxiliary mean AUC separately. Retain the supplied empty-history,1-16,17-64,>64 slices with sample/positive/negative counts; do not redefine bins after viewing results. Other required slices can only use host-authorized data/instrumentation; absent slices or user-cluster intervals remain explicitly unavailable.

Within this round compare only the protocol seed20262027. If a direction is retained, reserve paired repetitions only through a subsequent host-authorized interface that supports them, with prospective seed specification and no candidate config override of the frozen seed. Repeated fixed-seed runs test execution/timing reproducibility, not seed robustness. Paired user-cluster bootstrap is conditional on host-supported identities/predictions, never invented from forward inputs.
falsifiers: A fresh unchanged-control AUC differing from0.666753547526167 by more than0.0002 triggers a bridge investigation before using historical comparisons; do not call a mismatched source/protocol or execution failure scientific counterevidence. A matching bridge is still only one seed.

Either AUC preservation condition failing rejects that candidate utility for this screen. No candidate meeting the measured cost criterion rejects efficiency utility across these bounded width changes; it does not prove all existing capacity is necessary.

A candidate failing host finite forward/backward, four[B,1] bounded output checks, empty/noncontiguous mask invariance, unavailable-field handling or auxiliary gradient/buffer ownership is an implementation failure. Retain its charged receipt and repair only in a separately declared follow-up.

Before claiming repeated support, repeat candidate/reference measurement via the authorized host in matched, interleaved device conditions and require the median of at least3 timing ratios <=0.95 for p50 and <=1.02 for p95. If not available, report provisional single-pass cost only. Seed-robust AUC preservation remains unassessed unless additional paired seeds are authorized.

Equal or lower parameter count with unchanged/slower measured latency contradicts the prediction-cost hypothesis for that implementation. A width-related AUC change can reflect optimization or Dice behavior rather than information redundancy; current contrasts do not adjudicate that mechanism.
alternative_explanations: Different dimensions consume different RNG draws and change optimization geometry, regularization and Dice channel statistics; no claim to isolate redundant coordinates or a biological mechanism
Embedding-width change also changes scorer/tower input and residual output widths; it is a whole representation-width factor rather than embedding-table-only pruning
GPU kernel alignment at width12, device contention, warmup, loading and timing noise; parameter/MAC reductions alone do not establish a latency benefit
Only the current fixed-seed protocol is authorized; no seed-robustness claim from this suite

Auxiliary-task tradeoffs, history-length composition and training-frequency sensitivity can be hidden by population click AUC; report available diagnostics without treating exploratory slices as confirmatory.
No explicit compression-best receipt beyond the imported joint model is available. Retain baseline-din and the joint incumbent as supplied utility references; do not invent a missing comparison.

Prerequisite boundary: raw parquet files, feature-map instance, loader execution and GPU are not available in this coding workspace. Existing successful host receipts and matching candidate/baseline source hashes establish the inherited starting point; fresh data-digest, loader/visibility and device checks remain host-owned gates. Their absence here is unavailable evidence, not scientific failure. No new baseline execution is claimed.
